faq.q: How much does Jenny Legal charge?
faq.a: Jenny Legal publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Jenny Legal offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Jenny Legal publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Jenny Legal have offices?
faq.a: Jenny Legal publishes two offices, in Las Vegas and North Las Vegas. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Jenny Legal?
faq.a: Jenny Legal names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.
